kyoto_rung_arun_thai.gf_detail: Ask. Thai rice and rice-noodle dishes, but also fried spring rolls, egg noodles, fish-sauce and soy-based sauces; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use fish sauce, shrimp, pork or chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; bookings lapse 30 minutes after the time without contact; two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). 23 seats: 5 at the counter, 18 at tables; private hire 20–50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu with photos; takeaway (Tabelog). Third floor of 遊里香ビル on Kiyamachi above Sanjo, above a ramen shop; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 2 June 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi above Sanjo, lunch sets upstairs] A third-floor Thai room on Kiyamachi, opened in 2025, easy to miss above a ramen shop. Lunch sets of about ¥1,100–1,500 bring salad, soup, shrimp chips and a mini dessert with khao man gai, pad thai, green curry or tom yum noodles; staff will steer you to milder dishes. Dinner adds tom yum hot pot and seafood curry with Thai beer. English menu. Busy at lunch — book. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 2 June 2025, serving authentic Thai dishes in a wood-toned room for up to 23. Reviewers in 2026 describe friendly staff, kitchen staff who laughed along with a guest practising Thai, and a busy lunch trade.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets; pad thai; tom yum.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular asked the kitchen to teach the Thai phrase for a dish, mispronounced it into an unintended joke, and the whole room laughed — "something Thai people cherish."
"I asked the staff for recommendations on milder dishes, and I ended up having a delicious meal." — May 2026.
"It seems to be a popular spot; I was able to get in early in the evening, but it looked like later customers would have a hard time without a reservation." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タイ料理・東南アジア料理・エスニック、中京区上大阪町528 遊里香ビル3F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日・祝 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約可 (30分連絡なしで取消、混雑時2時間制)、23席 (カウンター5、テーブル18)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・PayPay 可、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、ベジタリアン対応あり、2025年6月2日オープン、トムヤムクン鍋、ガパオ、シーフードカレー、タイビール。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月、英語): ランチセット (サラダ、スープ、えびせん、ミニデザート)、カオマンガイ1,100円、パッタイ、グリーンカレー、トムヤムラーメン、ポーピアトート、ラートナー1,210円、スップノーマイ1,100円、昼は混む。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog); ask staff for milder dishes; cards and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya dishes including edamame tempura, a rare salmon cutlet, sushi rolls, hot pots and cheesecake; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-focused izakaya of sashimi, seafood rolls, katsuo tataki, salmon and fish hot pots (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday to Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday 15:00–23:00; Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted by phone; DMs are not answered during opening hours (Tabelog); 19:00 slots fill, with 90-minute seatings at busy times (March 2026). No table charge (Tabelog original チャージ料無し). Orders by smartphone (July 2026). 16 seats: 6 at a ground-floor counter, 10 at tables upstairs; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog). In the 三条食彩ろぉじ alley of small shops — look for the red noren (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo food alley, seafood rolls and edamame tempura] A small, young izakaya behind a red noren in a lane of tiny shops off Sanjo: sushi rolls heaped with seafood, edamame tempura, rare salmon cutlet, katsuo tataki and fish hot pots in winter, with fruit sours and sake. Staff are friendly and chatty, and both regulars and travellers fill it — book, as evening slots go fast. One August 2026 guest found the counter noisy. Orders go through your smartphone. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a young team cooking dish by dish in a small kitchen, friendly service and drink suggestions, many regulars, and a sister restaurant, SAUNA (April and August 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor stayed longer than planned, and on the way out one of the staff flashed a peace sign.
"The Edamame Tempura, a popular menu item, was especially tasty and disappeared quickly!" — March 2026.
"I had my meal at the counter, but it was quite noisy, possibly because there were many regular customers." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区道祐町135-1 三条食彩ろぉじ、月・水〜金 17:00〜23:00、土 15:00〜23:00、日 15:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可 (営業中はDMに返信できない)、チャージ料無し、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、カード・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年1月〜8月、英語): 若いスタッフ、姉妹店 SAUNA、海鮮こぼれ巻き、明太子巻き、鰹のたたき、いかのお造り、枝豆の天ぷら、サーモンのレアカツ、クリームチーズのディップ、鱧と松茸の天ぷら、冬は白子、ぶり鍋、日替わりのチーズケーキ、あまおうのサワー、スマホで注文、1階カウンター・2階テーブル、常連が多く騒がしいとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering; book by phone; no table charge; cards and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase kappo courses with dashi, soy-based sauces, saba sushi, ganmodoki and fried ginkgo; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of Setouchi fish, hamo, anago, sweetfish and duck liver, on dashi (official site; 2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday 18:30–23:30, last order 20:30; closed Wednesday (official site). Tabelog gives 18:00–24:00 with last seating 22:00, and lunch by reservation only; lunch serves the same courses as dinner (2025 review). Reservations through the official site (AutoReserve) or by phone (official site; Tabelog); book well ahead — locals fill it (June 2025). A fixed course of about ¥14,000–15,000 (2022–2024 reviews); reviewers spent ¥15,000–29,999 (2025–2026). 10 seats: 6 at the counter and one table of 4; non-smoking (Tabelog; February 2024). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site; Tabelog). Near the corner of the Daikokuya supermarket, Kitashirakawa, by Kyoto University; 3 min walk from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop (Tabelog; May 2022).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.notes: [Kappo · Kitashirakawa, a couple since 2009] A ten-seat kappo near Ginkakuji-michi, opened in 2009 by a husband and wife: the chef (trained at Kikunoi, reviewers say) cooks Setouchi fish and Ohara vegetables into a fixed omakase of around ¥15,000, and the okami, a sake sommelier per one reviewer, pairs local sake or wine. Generous, unfussy and warm, with leftover rice wrapped as onigiri. Popular with locals — book well ahead. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Okami (the wife of the owner, unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in Kitashirakawa in 2009 and run by a married couple; the owner honed skills at famous Kyoto restaurants and wanted a kappo that is easier and freer to enjoy; fish from the Seto Inland Sea and vegetables from Ohara. Reviewers say the owner seems to have trained at Kikunoi (October 2022) and that the chef trained at Kikunoi and the okami is a sake sommelier (February 2026). A September 2025 reviewer calls it a Michelin one-star restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A kappo to enjoy more closely and more freely" (official site).

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 guest on a fourth visit, coming only every year or two, was still remembered.
February and September, the low seasons in Kyoto, are a "special service month with more extravagant dishes" (February 2024).
A June 2025 guest who could not get a booking on an earlier trip — locals had taken every seat — called the hamo, cut with a large steel knife, the best of a lifetime.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・北白川の夫婦で営む隠れ家的な割烹、2009年開店、京都の名店で腕を磨いた店主、女将の気配り、瀬戸内の魚介と大原の野菜、地酒とイタリア・フランスのワイン、ペアリング、月・火・木〜日 18:30〜23:30 (L.O.20:30)、水曜休み、最寄りは元田中駅、駐車場なし、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、予約は公式サイトから。食べログ: 日本料理、左京区北白川久保田町26、銀閣寺道バス停から徒歩3分、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)、昼は予約のみ。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年2月、英語): Kikunoi で修業したという店主、女将は sake sommelier、おまかせ14,000円ほど、2月と9月は特別に豪華、鱧、伝助穴子、ぐじのお椀、八寸、鯖寿司、ご飯の残りはおにぎりに、ミシュラン一つ星との記述 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online through the official site (multilingual) well ahead; fixed omakase; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_synager.gf_detail: Ask. A French tasting course with sauces, terrines, fried amuse-bouches, bread, butter and baked sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a set French course of fish, shellfish, foie gras and meat, with butter and cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last food order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:00); closed Monday, open on holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). Courses with wine or non-alcoholic aroma pairings: lunch with four pairings a little over ¥12,000 (September 2026); bills ¥10,000–29,999 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 12 seats; private hire for 6 or more, children welcome when booked whole (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). A renovated machiya down a cobbled alley through a small wooden gate, Higashinotoin north of Nijo; 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (subway) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.notes: [French · Higashinotoin Nijo, aromas and non-alcoholic pairings] A twelve-seat French restaurant in a renovated machiya down a cobbled alley near the Imperial Palace, where a chef who is also an herb coordinator builds the course around scent — it opens with rose-distilled water — and pairs it with wine or with non-alcoholic aroma drinks made by herb distillation. Fish, foie gras, game and flower-strewn plates; one diner found the meat sauces rich. Lunch with four pairings is a little over ¥12,000; 10% service. English spoken. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a "unique style: chef × herb coordinator × sommelier"; a chef's course viewed over the kitchen and courtyard, paired with wines by the sommelier or with aroma pairings created by herb distillation. Reviewers in 2026 describe a warm owner greeting guests (February 2026), a team of male staff (September 2026) and a dining room opened up by removing part of the first-floor ceiling of a two-storey house (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The chef's wish is for you to enjoy your meal time to the fullest" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner took the full non-alcoholic pairing — kombucha and other drinks standing in for the acidity of white wine, the tannins of red and the sweetness of port — and called it the right decision.
"The sauce for the meat dishes was a bit too rich for my taste, as I'm not fond of spices" — July 2026.
A September 2026 guest found a vegetable mentioned as disliked still appeared in one dish — a small piece, eaten anyway.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・創作料理、中京区東洞院二条上ル壺屋町512-2、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩4分、昼 12:00〜15:00 (料理L.O.13:00)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.19:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業)、完全予約制、サービス料10%、12席、6名以上で貸切可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、シェフ兼ハーブコーディネーター、ソムリエのワインペアリング、ハーブ蒸留のアロマペアリング (ノンアルコール)。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 町家を改装、ダマスクローズの香りの水、Shinshu salmon とキャビア、Yamato tachibana、鱧、まぐろのタルタル、牡蠣のフラン、フォアグラのテリーヌ、ヒグマ、ふぐのジュレ、チーズの盛り合わせ、焼き菓子、昼は4種のペアリングで12,000円あまり。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); reservation only; 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_da_ciro.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant cannot handle dietary needs or allergies raised on the day (Tabelog). Courses include fresh pasta, focaccia, pizza fritta and baked sweets (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_da_ciro.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: vegetable-led courses but with fish, meat, cheese and cured meats in most dishes (2025–26 reviews). Ask when booking.
kyoto_da_ciro.hours_raw: Lunch Tue–Sun and holidays from 12:00 (12:00–15:00); dinner Tue–Sat and holidays, starting at 18:00 or 19:00 (to 22:00); no dinner on Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only; tell the restaurant of any dietary needs or allergies, including companions’, when booking — none can be handled on the day (Tabelog). Courses: lunch ¥7,500 (7 dishes), lunch with five-drink pairing ¥12,700 (non-alcoholic ¥9,900), dinner ¥15,730 (9 dishes) (Tabelog). Service charge 5% at lunch, 10% at dinner (Tabelog, Japanese text). À la carte on two days every two months (July 2026). 9 counter seats on the fifth floor; private hire; non-smoking, smoking space available; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 April 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_da_ciro.notes: [Creative Italian · Gion, a sommelier-chef's nine-seat counter] A quiet fifth-floor counter north of Shijo where the owner-chef, also a sommelier, builds playful seasonal courses around vegetables — a corn soup served with corn pizza and corn gelato, figs four ways, cold pasta with peach and burrata — then lets you choose the size of the final pasta by the 10 g. Lunch ¥7,500, dinner ¥15,730, with wine or non-alcoholic pairings; 5–10% service. Give allergies when booking. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a freestyle Italian restaurant where the owner-chef combines techniques and ingredients freely, with wines from a specialist shop and pairing as part of the concept. A May 2026 reviewer notes the chef is also a sommelier; reviewers describe the chef as approachable and often at the counter explaining dishes (May and October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal vegetable courses; pasta by weight; focaccia.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner who could not choose between four white wines was offered two 50 ml pours.
A July 2026 diner found the pairing pours only 50 cc and ordered a glass of white instead.
A July 2026 regular said à la carte is offered on just two days every two months.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・イノベーティブ、東山区祇園町北側266 井澤ビル 5F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、昼 12:00 スタート (12:00〜15:00、火〜日・祝)、夜 18:00 か 19:00 スタート (〜22:00、火〜土・祝)、日曜は夜なし、月曜休み、完全予約制、アレルギーや苦手なものは予約時に (当日は対応不可)、ランチ7,500円、ペアリング付き12,700円 (ノンアルコール9,900円)、ディナー15,730円、サービス料 ランチ5% ディナー10%、カウンター9席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2023年4月25日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 野菜中心の創作コース、ソムリエでもあるシェフ、パスタは10g 単位、フォカッチャの持ち帰り、2か月に2日だけのアラカルト、ペアリングは50cc という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and give allergies at booking; set course; cards, e-money and QR accepted.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Dietary restrictions and allergies, including companions’, must be given at booking or before arrival; none can be accommodated on the day.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kogamo.gf_detail: Ask. Courses include tempura and a soy- or ponzu-seasoned hot pot; grilled duck and horse sashimi are served with condiments and ponzu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kogamo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a duck and horse-meat restaurant; the hot pot is cooked with duck (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kogamo.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Ingredients are limited, so an early booking or a course is recommended; ask for horse meat when booking, as supply is limited (Tabelog; September 2025). Courses: Kyoto duck salt-grill course ¥7,900, duck hot pot course ¥9,700, horse and duck hot pot course ¥12,900 — the hot pots in autumn and winter (Tabelog). 12 seats at a hinoki counter facing the open kitchen; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). Bookings for one are accepted (September 2026). In a small alley off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 13 July 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kogamo.notes: [Duck & horse meat · Kawaramachi Sanjo, a hinoki counter in an alley] A 12-seat counter tucked off Kawaramachi where the cooks serve Kyoto duck — as yukhoe, sashimi so fresh it barely needs the hot pot, salt-grilled or roasted — alongside tender horse sashimi and liver, with Kyoto vegetables as salad and tempura. In autumn and winter the duck hot pot in a copper pot is the draw. Courses ¥7,900–12,900; ask for horse meat when booking. Solo diners welcome. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Kyoto vegetables, Kyoto duck and horse meat prepared by chefs specialising in Kyoto cuisine, at a hinoki counter with an open kitchen; opened 13 July 2013. Reviewers note the chef’s care over seasoning and the order of dishes (March 2025) and passion for the ingredients (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto duck; horse sashimi; duck hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 diner loved the horse liver but found the menu a little limited.
A September 2026 solo diner felt unwell mid-course; the staff were kind as the diner left early.
A September 2026 diner wished for more dishes unique to the restaurant, as many are simply grilled or in hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 馬肉料理・日本料理・居酒屋、中京区河原町三条下ル大黒町46-1、三条駅から徒歩約3分、火〜日 18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00)、月曜休み、食材に限りがあるため早めの予約かコースを、京鴨の塩焼きコース7,900円、鴨鍋コース9,700円、桜肉と鴨の鍋コース12,900円 (鍋は秋冬)、12席、檜のカウンターとオープンキッチン、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・QR 可、2013年7月13日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 鴨のユッケ、鴨の刺身、桜肉の刺身、レバー刺し、銅鍋の鴨鍋と雑炊、京野菜の天ぷら、生麩の天ぷら、馬肉は予約時に伝えると確実、メニューが少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; ask for horse meat when booking; solo diners accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kogamo.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26025700/ (35.008505, 135.769899); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区大黒町46番地 (lot) 18m; 2026-11-05

kyoto_sushi_rakumi.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi with soy, marinated fish and sauces, plus cooked dishes such as fried sea bream (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_sushi_rakumi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase of fish and shellfish (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_rakumi.hours_raw: Two sittings, starting 17:00 and 19:30, about two hours each; closed Sunday and the second and fourth Mondays — ask about holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only; bookings for the month after next open at the start of each month; cancellation charges 50% three days before, 80% two days before, 100% the day before or on the day (Tabelog). Card payment only, no cash; service charge included in the course price (Tabelog, Japanese text). 8 counter seats of a single slab of cypress, with a waiting room and bar upstairs overlooking the river; private hire (Tabelog; October 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the Shirakawa north of Shijo; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 11 January 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_rakumi.notes: [Sushi · Gion Shirakawa, Gion Sasaki's sushi counter] An eight-seat cypress counter on the Shirakawa, produced by Gion Sasaki and led by chef Kazuya Nomura, from Toyama. The omakase moves from Kyoto-style small dishes — abalone with its liver risotto, chawanmushi, seasonal sashimi — to Edomae nigiri on red- and white-vinegar rice. A cheerful, chatty counter; on some nights most guests are from abroad (2025). Card only, service included; about ¥20,000–50,000. Two sittings, 17:00 and 19:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): sushi chefs trained at Gion Sasaki and Sushi Yoshitake; the sushi concept of Gion Sasaki, blending Kyoto dashi with Edomae technique. An October 2025 reviewer says the chef is from Toyama; reviewers describe a cheerful, friendly chef and a lively counter (October 2025 to October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "learning from the past to create the new."
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae sushi with red- and white-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner liked the cooking but found the seasoning slightly salty and the sushi, about seven pieces, a little few for a big appetite.
An October 2025 diner found the Akashi sea bream sashimi exquisite but missed explanations of the dishes.
A six-time regular looks forward to the lotus root served with the gari on every visit (November 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司・海鮮・日本料理、東山区三吉町332-6、三条駅から徒歩5分、2部制 (17:00〜、19:30〜、約2時間)、日曜・第2・第4月曜休み、完全予約制、翌々月の予約は月初から、キャンセル料3日前50%・2日前80%・前日と当日100%、カードのみ (現金不可)、サービス料はコース料金に含む、カウンター8席 (一枚板)、2階に待合、貸切可、禁煙、2019年1月11日オープン、祇園さゝ木の寿司、料理人 Kazuya Nomura、京の出汁と江戸前、赤酢と白酢のシャリ。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 白川沿い、Toyama 出身の大将、漬けのまぐろ、鮑と肝のリゾット、茶碗蒸し、明るく気さくな店、塩味がやや強いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book two months ahead at the start of the month; card only; strict cancellation fees.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sushi_rakumi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26031820/ (35.006730, 135.776051); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区三吉町332番地 (lot) 25m; 2026-11-05

kyoto_kinmata.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a whole: tempura is central — the lunch tendon, the sesame-tofu tempura and the counter’s fried "uni bread" — alongside a dashi-and-soy kaiseki (2026 reviews). Ask about a kaiseki without fried dishes.
kyoto_kinmata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki built on dashi, with fish and wagyu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kinmata.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 and dinner 17:30–19:00 are the last seatings (counter lunch to 13:00, counter dinner from 18:00); closed mainly on Wednesday, irregularly — see the calendar on the official site (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; a booking may be cancelled if the guest cannot be reached 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text). Tatami-room lunch kaiseki ¥10,000, ¥15,000 and ¥20,000 for 2–8 (Tabelog); tempura-bowl lunches ¥2,200–5,750 (March 2026); dinners about ¥20,000–60,000 (March 2026). 50 seats: a 9-seat counter and six tatami rooms for 2 to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Near Nishiki Market; 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_kinmata.notes: [Kaiseki · Nishiki, an 1801 inn-turned-kaiseki house] A registered-heritage Kyoto townhouse by Nishiki Market that began in 1801 as an inn for medicine merchants from Omi and still serves kaiseki in tatami rooms around a small courtyard garden. Book a private room for a seasonal kaiseki (lunch from ¥10,000), or sit at the 9-seat counter for the theatrical uni bread and hojicha chazuke — or a tempura-bowl lunch from ¥2,200. Eighth-generation family run; 15% service. Mainly closed Wednesday.

roles: Family-run house; seventh- and eighth-generation owners (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1801 (Kyowa 1) as an inn for medicine merchants from Omi under the name 近江屋; the fourth-generation 又八 renamed it 近又, from 近 of 近江 and 又 of 又八. Reviewers met the seventh- and eighth-generation owners (March 2026) and heard stories from the eighth generation (August 2026); a June 2026 diner had breakfast there before.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki; sesame-tofu tempura; uni bread.

anecdotes.text: A February 2023 diner who had said at booking that raw fish was a problem was served sea bream sashimi; the owner ran after the diner to apologise.
A March 2026 diner waited about 50 minutes for a tempura bowl while a course guest was served first.
A September 2026 couple, too full to finish, were given the rest of the saury kamameshi as rice balls to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kinmata.com): 創業1801年 (享和元年) の京懐石料理店、登録有形文化財の京町家、近江の国からの薬商人の定宿として始まり、初代又八が「近江屋」として宿を始め、四代目又八の代に「近又」と改名、錦市場の材料、少人数向けのカウンター席「近また」は昼はミニ懐石や天ぷら、夜は天ぷらコースや鉄板焼きを含む料理長の特別コース。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区大日町407、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、昼 12:00〜13:30・夜 17:30〜19:00 (最終入店、カウンターは昼13:00まで・夜18:00から)、主に水曜不定休、サービス料15％、座敷の昼懐石10,000円・15,000円・20,000円、50席 (カウンター9席と座敷6室)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2023年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 七代目と八代目、天丼のランチ2,200〜5,750円、胡麻豆腐の天ぷら、カウンターの Uni Bread、ほうじ茶の出汁茶漬け、天丼を50分ほど待ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a tatami room or the counter; staff explain each dish; 15% service charge.

existence.note: Official site with a business calendar and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_jintora_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask. Soft serve with shichimi or sansho mixed in; whether it comes in a cone or a cup, and the cone’s ingredients, are not stated (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_jintora_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk soft serve (2026 reviews). The spice blends are sold separately to take home.
kyoto_jintora_nishiki.hours_raw: Official site: 10:00–18:00, open every day except at New Year. Tabelog gives 9:30–18:00. No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). 4 seats for eating in (Tabelog; March 2025). Inside Nishiki Market, 3 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (official site). Sansho products limited to two bags a person because of scarce supply (official site).
kyoto_jintora_nishiki.notes: [Sweets · Nishiki Market, shichimi soft serve] A Nishiki Market spice shop that has blended shichimi since 1878 and, on the side, swirls it into soft serve: pale pink, sweet at first, then a gentle heat that tickles the throat. There is a sansho version too (¥480 in 2026). Four seats to eat in; buy a jar of yuzu shichimi on the way out. Open daily 10:00–18:00.

roles: Family spice house (operator ぢんとら Co., Ltd.)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Meiji 11 (1878), blending fragrant shichimi passed down from one heir to the next, in Nishiki Market.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 visitor asked how hot it was; the staff said not very, but that the throat would tingle later — so the visitor cautiously ordered a mixed swirl.
A January 2025 visitor bought three jars of yuzu shichimi as light souvenirs and ended up keeping the jars at home after the family raved about the yuzu shichimi in a hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぢんとら、創業明治11年、一子相伝の七味、中京区中魚屋町494 (錦市場内)、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、10:00〜18:00、無休 (年始は休み)、京七味、一味、柚こしょう、山椒、七味・山椒ソフトクリーム、山椒は入手困難のため1人2袋まで。食べログ: 9:30〜18:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、4席。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 七味ソフトクリーム430円 (2026年7月は480円)、山椒ソフトクリーム480円、ピンク色、甘さのあとに喉にピリッと、柚子七味は約450円。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-up counter in Nishiki Market; four seats.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.gf_detail: Ask. Bouillabaisse of fish and shellfish served with focaccia; starters include quiche and pâté; a cutlet in one course; canelé to take away; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a bouillabaisse house built on fish stock, with duck and pâté among the starters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 12:30, drinks 14:00) Thursday–Sunday; dinner 17:00–22:30 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 21:30) Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday and some Tuesdays and Wednesdays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (card details for Tabelog online booking); à la carte bookings on the day only; 100% cancellation fee the day before for the private-room bouillabaisse course (Tabelog). No service charge; one drink per person at dinner (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, 6 in a sunken-kotatsu private room (Tabelog). Non-smoking; ashtray outside (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Off Takakura north of Bukkoji, 5 min from Shijo and Karasuma Stns (Tabelog). Opened 25 October 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.notes: [French bistro · Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto’s bouillabaisse house] A small counter bistro off Takakura that makes one thing its business: bouillabaisse, rich with seafood and built from fish trimmings. The ¥3,600 lunch brings a crowded starter plate and the day’s bouillabaisse — sea bream, mussels, vegetables — with focaccia; dinner courses add fish starters and a meat main. Take a canelé home. Book ahead (counter seats are few); one drink each at dinner; closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Nice (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the chef trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Nice, and the restaurant is listed in Gault&Millau POP. Tabelog gives the opening as 25 October 2020. An October 2026 reviewer took the calm host to be a female owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: The signature bouillabaisse uses fish trimmings that would otherwise be discarded (shop’s Tabelog text).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest, nervous about French table manners, found there was nothing to worry about.
A November 2026 diner had the chef’s course built around a sweetfish bouillabaisse.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブイヤベースのお店 プチポワソン、ビストロ・フレンチ、下京区高倉通仏光寺上ル西前町374-1、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (木〜日)、夜17:00〜22:30 (火〜日、料理L.O.20:00)、月曜と一部の火・水休み、予約可、アラカルトは当日予約のみ、サービス料なし、ディナーは1ドリンク制、カード・電子マネー・QR可、13席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつ6)、禁煙、英語メニュー、2020年10月25日オープン。店の取り組み: 捨てられる魚のアラでブイヤベース。口コミ (2026年、英語): 昼のブイヤベースセット3,600円、前菜の盛り合わせ (鴨、豆腐、キッシュ、キャロットラペ、パテ)、鯛のブイヤベース、HANAKAGO のフォカッチャ、持ち帰りのカヌレ、シェフはニースの星付きで修業、Gault&Millau POP。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book ahead; one drink per person at dinner.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Fish small plates with white wine; bread with the ajillo and pan con tomate, a monaka-wafer otoshi, fried monkfish, squid-ink rice croquettes and fries are not gluten-free (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-seafood bar (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–24:00 on weekdays, 14:00–24:00 on weekends and holidays; lunch with white wine is served upstairs at 魚料理あぎやお from 12:00. Tabelog: 17:00–23:00 Monday–Thursday, 12:00–23:00 Friday–Sunday and holidays; irregular closures. Reservations accepted; take care not to book the 2nd-floor restaurant by mistake; ¥7,700 cancellation fee from two days before (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥550 per person (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter, two tables for four, a counter private room for five (room fee ¥2,500) (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children only in the private room (Tabelog). About 10 m east of the Gojo–Higashinotoin crossing, 2 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.notes: [Wine bar · Gojo, fish and white wine] A grown-up bar at Gojo–Higashinotoin built on a simple pairing: seasonal fish and a long list of white wine, poured to your taste. Start with the taiyaki-shaped monaka otoshi, then small plates — sea urchin on pan con tomate, kohada, ajillo with bread, grilled kinmedai, a soup paella. The fish restaurant agiyao is upstairs; book the right floor. ¥550 otoshi; open until midnight.

roles: Owner (named Aoyagi in a September 2026 review), who also runs fish restaurants; kitchen chef (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the owner, Aoyagi, also runs Uo Ryori Aoyagi near Gion and is involved in a wine shop; the sister restaurant 魚料理あぎやお is upstairs in the same building, which an October 2026 reviewer says holds a Michelin star. Tabelog gives the opening as 3 February 2014.
chef_bio.philosophy: Supporting Kyoto’s food culture and local producers with Kyoto ingredients (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Fish small plates with white wine.

anecdotes.text: On a September 2026 day when the chef had just left, the owner was cooking and serving alone, and the lunchtime guest got to eat the owner’s own cooking.
Four friends in October 2026 got through about fifteen glasses of white wine, poured in a considered order.
An October 2026 visitor found the master intimidating at first, then friendly and full of wine recommendations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: お魚と白ワインのバル agiyao、下京区深草町592-3 1階、旬の魚と豊富な白ワインの大人のバル、京都産の食材で京都の食文化と地元産業を応援、平日17時〜24時、土日祝14時〜24時、白ワインのランチは2階の魚料理あぎやおで12時から。食べログ: 月〜木 17:00〜23:00、金〜日祝 12:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、2日前からキャンセル料7,700円、お通し550円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、24席 (カウンター8、テーブル4人×2、個室5人、個室料2,500円)、禁煙、2014年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 店主の Aoyagi さんは Gion 近くの魚料理店も営む、2階の姉妹店はミシュランの星、たい焼き型の最中のお通し、雲丹のパンコントマテ、アヒージョ、金目鯛の焼き物、スープパエリア、白ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥550 otoshi; book the right floor (bar on 1F, restaurant on 2F); cancellation fee from two days before.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of sourdough, croissants, pain de mie and baguette sandwiches (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Croissants, condensed-milk butter bread and sandwiches use dairy, egg and meat; the levain and other lean breads are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.hours_raw: Opens from about 7:00 (sometimes 6:00); the day’s opening time is posted on Instagram; closed Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; July–October 2026). Closing time not given; long breaks are announced (one until 26 August in 2026). Queues at opening — 40 minutes in July 2026 — easier around 10:00 (2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog; July 2026). Takeaway bakery; seats not listed (Tabelog). In a back lane near Nijo Castle, a brick building with a spiral stair, 5–6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Began as an event stall; shop opened at the end of 2019 (October 2026 review).
kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.notes: [Bakery · Nijo Castle, hard bread at first light] A hidden bakery in a back lane near Nijo Castle — brick front, spiral stair — that opens around 7 a.m. (check Instagram that morning) and draws a queue for its sourdough, deeply buttery croissants and pain de mie. The sandwiches are the other reason to come: chicken and gorgonzola, a stacked BLT, a ¥1,000 fig fruit sandwich. Cash only; Thursday to Sunday; arrive at opening or around ten.

roles: Baker-owner (unnamed in Tabelog; one review thanks “Masamichi” and the baker’s wife)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: it began as an event vendor and opened its shop at the end of 2019. Another October 2026 regular thanked "Masamichi and your wife".

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor waited 40 minutes after a 7 a.m. opening and left with twelve items for ¥5,620.
An October 2026 regular calls these the best croissants of a lifetime, rich with butter yet never heavy, and still fairly priced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: kurs、パン、中京区西大黒町334 コーポラス二条1F、二条城前駅から430m、朝7時から (その日の開店時間は Instagram で)、月・火・水休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 自家製の天然酵母のルヴァン、クロワッサン、テレビで紹介されたパンドミ、鶏とゴルゴンゾーラ500円、BLT650円、クロックマダム550円、いちじくのフルーツサンド1,000円、ソーセージパン600円、行列、現金のみ、イベント出店から始まり2019年末に店舗。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; check Instagram for the opening time; queues at opening.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.
